Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Macros are now their own item next to "Artificial intelligence"; new steps (tap a place, select and speak an object) and the condition "Run only when".
• Voices by language and alphabet (Cyrillic, Latin) in speech settings.
• Diagnostics: a diary of what the app does, saved to Downloads/Nika.
• Fixed: back tap firing when the phone is turned over (single tap removed); Direct touch is now with the touch settings.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
